name: DimControlRun
definition:
CREATE   VIEW cxcontrol.DimControlRun AS
SELECT r.*,
 CONVERT(nvarchar(40),CASE WHEN b.BaselineKey IS NOT NULL THEN 'ROP_BASELINE'
  WHEN ip.Purpose='ORDER_INQUIRY' THEN 'SELECTED_MILP_INQUIRY'
  WHEN ip.Purpose='PIPELINE_SMOKE' THEN 'PIPELINE_SMOKE'
  WHEN JSON_VALUE(i.RequestJSON,'$.schema')='companyx.inquiry.request.v2' THEN 'UNCLASSIFIED_INQUIRY'
  ELSE 'PIPELINE_SMOKE' END) RunPurpose,
 CONVERT(nvarchar(40),CASE WHEN b.BaselineKey IS NOT NULL THEN 'FIXED_PRESET'
  ELSE COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(i.RequestJSON,'$.initialization_mode'),'LEGACY_SMOKE') END) InitializationMode,
 CONVERT(nvarchar(100),COALESCE(b.BaselineID,ref.BaselineID,'NOT_APPLICABLE')) ReferenceBaselineID,
 CONVERT(int,COALESCE(b.ScenarioIndex,ref.ScenarioIndex,0)) PhysicalScenarioIndex,
 CONVERT(nvarchar(50),CASE WHEN b.BaselineKey IS NOT NULL THEN b.InitialStateRule
  ELSE COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(i.RequestJSON,'$.initial_stock_rule'),'LEGACY') END) RequestedInitialStockRule
FROM cxolap.DimRun r
LEFT JOIN cxcontrol.Baseline b ON b.PlanningRunKey=r.PlanningRunKey
LEFT JOIN cxcontrol.Candidate c ON c.PlanningRunKey=r.PlanningRunKey
LEFT JOIN cxcontrol.Inquiry i ON i.InquiryKey=c.InquiryKey
LEFT JOIN cxcontrol.InquiryPurpose ip ON ip.InquiryKey=i.InquiryKey
LEFT JOIN cxcontrol.Baseline ref ON ref.PlanningRunKey=TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(i.RequestJSON,'$.base_run_key'));

name: FactInquiryLineDelivery
definition:
CREATE   VIEW cxcontrol.FactInquiryLineDelivery AS
WITH Delivery AS(
 SELECT c.PlanningRunKey,l.InquiryLineKey,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.EventCode='SHIP_ON_TIME' THEN e.Quantity ELSE 0 END) OnTimeQty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.EventCode='SHIP_LATE' THEN e.Quantity ELSE 0 END) LateQty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.EventCode='LOST_SALE' THEN e.Quantity ELSE 0 END) LostQty,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.EventCode IN('SHIP_ON_TIME','SHIP_LATE') THEN e.EventAt END) LastShipmentAt
 FROM cxcontrol.InquiryLine l JOIN cxcontrol.Tranche t ON t.TrancheKey=l.TrancheKey
 JOIN cxcontrol.Candidate c ON c.CandidateKey=t.CandidateKey
 JOIN cxcontrol.Inquiry i ON i.InquiryKey=c.InquiryKey
 LEFT JOIN dss.Fact_SimulationEvent e ON e.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
 AND e.EntityCode=CONCAT('SO_LINE:',l.SourceSalesOrderDetailID)
 AND e.EventCode IN('SHIP_ON_TIME','SHIP_LATE','LOST_SALE')
 AND CONVERT(date,e.EventAt) BETWEEN i.KnownAt AND i.AnalysisEnd
 GROUP BY c.PlanningRunKey,l.InquiryLineKey
)
SELECT l.InquiryLineKey,i.InquiryKey,c.CandidateKey,t.TrancheKey,c.PlanningRunKey,
 l.ProductKey,sp.StockUnitMeasureKey,CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.KnownAt,112)) KnownDateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),t.DueDate,112)) DueDateKey,
 CASE WHEN d.OnTimeQty+d.LateQty>=l.RequestedQty THEN COALESCE(CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),d.LastShipmentAt,112)),0) ELSE 0 END CompletionDateKey,
 l.RequestedQty,d.OnTimeQty,d.LateQty,CONVERT(decimal(28,8),d.OnTimeQty+d.LateQty) FilledQty,d.LostQty,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),l.RequestedQty-d.OnTimeQty-d.LateQty-d.LostQty) EndingBacklogQty,
 CONVERT(bigint,1) InquiryLineCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN d.OnTimeQty+d.LateQty>=l.RequestedQty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CompletedLineCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN d.OnTimeQty>=l.RequestedQty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OnTimeCompleteLineCount
FROM cxcontrol.InquiryLine l JOIN cxcontrol.Tranche t ON t.TrancheKey=l.TrancheKey
JOIN cxcontrol.Candidate c ON c.CandidateKey=t.CandidateKey
JOIN cxcontrol.Inquiry i ON i.InquiryKey=c.InquiryKey
JOIN cxolap.DimRun r ON r.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
JOIN dss.RunEntity re ON re.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey AND re.EntityCode=CONCAT('SO_LINE:',l.SourceSalesOrderDetailID)
 AND re.ProductKey=l.ProductKey AND re.EntityType='CUSTOMER_ORDER_LINE'
JOIN dss.Scenario_Product sp ON sp.ScenarioVersionKey=r.ScenarioVersionKey AND sp.ProductKey=l.ProductKey
JOIN Delivery d ON d.InquiryLineKey=l.InquiryLineKey AND d.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey;

name: FactInquiryTranche
definition:
CREATE   VIEW cxcontrol.FactInquiryTranche AS
SELECT i.InquiryKey,c.CandidateKey,t.TrancheKey,c.PlanningRunKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.KnownAt,112)) KnownDateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),t.DueDate,112)) DueDateKey,
 COALESCE(CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),f.CompletedAt,112)),0) CompletionDateKey,
 f.OrderStatus,CONVERT(bigint,1) TrancheCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN f.OrderStatus='FULFILLED' AND CONVERT(date,f.CompletedAt)<=i.AnalysisEnd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CompletedTrancheCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN f.OrderStatus='FULFILLED' AND CONVERT(date,f.CompletedAt)<=t.DueDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OnTimeCompleteTrancheCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN f.OrderStatus='LOST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) LostTrancheCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,f.ExpectedLineCount) RequestedLineCount
FROM cxcontrol.Tranche t JOIN cxcontrol.Candidate c ON c.CandidateKey=t.CandidateKey
JOIN cxcontrol.Inquiry i ON i.InquiryKey=c.InquiryKey
JOIN cxolap.DimRun r ON r.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
JOIN dss.Fact_SimulationOrder f ON f.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey AND f.CustomerOrderCode=CONCAT('SO:',t.SourceSalesOrderID);

name: FactInquiryWindowSummary
definition:
CREATE   VIEW cxcontrol.FactInquiryWindowSummary AS
SELECT c.PlanningRunKey,c.InquiryKey,c.CandidateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.KnownAt,112)) WindowStartDateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.AnalysisEnd,112)) WindowEndDateKey,
 TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(i.RequestJSON,'$.base_run_key')) ReferenceRunKey,
 d.CalendarDays WindowDays,d.InventoryValueDaySum WindowInventoryValueDaySum,
 CONVERT(float,d.InventoryValueDaySum)/NULLIF(d.CalendarDays,0) WindowAverageInventoryValue,
 o.DueOrderCount WindowDueOrderCount,o.OnTimeFullOrderCount WindowOnTimeFullOrderCount,
 CONVERT(float,o.OnTimeFullOrderCount)/NULLIF(o.DueOrderCount,0) WindowOTIF,
 rd.CalendarDays ReferenceROPDays,
 CONVERT(float,rd.InventoryValueDaySum)/NULLIF(rd.CalendarDays,0) ReferenceROPAverageInventoryValue,
 ro.DueOrderCount ReferenceROPDueOrderCount,ro.OnTimeFullOrderCount ReferenceROPOnTimeFullOrderCount,
 CONVERT(float,ro.OnTimeFullOrderCount)/NULLIF(ro.DueOrderCount,0) ReferenceROPOTIF
FROM cxcontrol.Candidate c JOIN cxcontrol.Inquiry i ON i.InquiryKey=c.InquiryKey
JOIN cxolap.DimRun r ON r.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
OUTER APPLY(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.DateKey) CalendarDays,SUM(f.InventoryValueDaySum) InventoryValueDaySum
 FROM cxcontrol.FactSimulationDaily f WHERE f.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
 AND f.DateKey BETWEEN CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.KnownAt,112)) AND CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.AnalysisEnd,112))) d
OUTER APPLY(SELECT SUM(f.DueOrderCount) DueOrderCount,SUM(f.OnTimeFullOrderCount) OnTimeFullOrderCount
 FROM cxolap.FactOrderService f WHERE f.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
 AND f.DueDateKey BETWEEN CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.KnownAt,112)) AND CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.AnalysisEnd,112))) o
OUTER APPLY(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.DateKey) CalendarDays,SUM(f.InventoryValueDaySum) InventoryValueDaySum
 FROM cxcontrol.FactSimulationDaily f WHERE f.PlanningRunKey=TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(i.RequestJSON,'$.base_run_key'))
 AND f.DateKey BETWEEN CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.KnownAt,112)) AND CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.AnalysisEnd,112))) rd
OUTER APPLY(SELECT SUM(f.DueOrderCount) DueOrderCount,SUM(f.OnTimeFullOrderCount) OnTimeFullOrderCount
 FROM cxolap.FactOrderService f WHERE f.PlanningRunKey=TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(i.RequestJSON,'$.base_run_key'))
 AND f.DueDateKey BETWEEN CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.KnownAt,112)) AND CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.AnalysisEnd,112))) ro;

name: FactOrderLineService
definition:
CREATE   VIEW cxcontrol.FactOrderLineService AS
SELECT f.PlanningRunKey,f.EntityCode,f.ProductKey,sp.StockUnitMeasureKey,
 f.DueDateKey,COALESCE(f.CompletionDateKey,0) CompletionDateKey,
 f.CustomerOrderCode,f.EvaluationCohort,f.IsDueInEvaluationPeriod,
 f.ObligationQty,f.OTUDemandQty,f.OTUOnTimeQty,f.OnTimeQty,f.LateQty,f.FilledQty,f.LostQty,
 f.UnfilledQtyAtEnd,f.OverdueUnfilledQtyAtEnd,f.LateUnitDays,
 f.CompletionLateDays,CONVERT(bigint,1) LineCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN f.CompletionDateKey IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CompletedLineCount,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),CASE WHEN f.IsDueInEvaluationPeriod=1 THEN f.FilledQty ELSE 0 END) DueCohortFilledQty,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),CASE WHEN f.IsDueInEvaluationPeriod=1 THEN f.LostQty ELSE 0 END) DueCohortLostQty,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),CASE WHEN f.IsDueInEvaluationPeriod=1 THEN f.UnfilledQtyAtEnd ELSE 0 END) DueCohortEndingBacklogQty
FROM cxolap.OrderLineSnapshot f
JOIN cxcontrol.EligibleRunSnapshot r ON r.PlanningRunKey=f.PlanningRunKey
JOIN dss.Scenario_Product sp ON sp.ScenarioVersionKey=r.ScenarioVersionKey AND sp.ProductKey=f.ProductKey;

name: FactProductionActivity
definition:
CREATE   VIEW cxcontrol.FactProductionActivity AS
SELECT c.InquiryKey,c.CandidateKey,f.PlanningRunKey,f.DateKey,f.ProductKey,sp.StockUnitMeasureKey,
 f.EventCode,f.Quantity,CONVERT(bigint,1) ActivityCount
FROM dss.Fact_SimulationEvent f JOIN cxcontrol.Candidate c ON c.PlanningRunKey=f.PlanningRunKey
JOIN cxcontrol.Inquiry i ON i.InquiryKey=c.InquiryKey
JOIN cxolap.DimRun r ON r.PlanningRunKey=f.PlanningRunKey
JOIN dss.Scenario_Product sp ON sp.ScenarioVersionKey=r.ScenarioVersionKey AND sp.ProductKey=f.ProductKey
WHERE f.EventCode IN('PRODUCTION_REQUEST','PRODUCTION_START','PRODUCTION_GOOD','BOM_ISSUE','BUY_ORDER')
AND CONVERT(date,f.EventAt) BETWEEN i.KnownAt AND i.AnalysisEnd
AND JSON_VALUE(c.ScopeJSON,'$.schema')<>'companyx.inquiry.scope.v2'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.InquiryKey,c.CandidateKey,a.PlanningRunKey,a.DateKey,a.ProductKey,sp.StockUnitMeasureKey,
 a.EventCode,a.Quantity,a.EventCount ActivityCount
FROM cxcontrol.InquiryActivity a JOIN cxcontrol.Candidate c ON c.PlanningRunKey=a.PlanningRunKey
JOIN cxcontrol.Inquiry i ON i.InquiryKey=c.InquiryKey
JOIN cxolap.DimRun r ON r.PlanningRunKey=a.PlanningRunKey
JOIN dss.Scenario_Product sp ON sp.ScenarioVersionKey=r.ScenarioVersionKey AND sp.ProductKey=a.ProductKey
WHERE JSON_VALUE(c.ScopeJSON,'$.schema')='companyx.inquiry.scope.v2'
AND a.EventCode IN('PRODUCTION_REQUEST','PRODUCTION_START','PRODUCTION_GOOD','BOM_ISSUE','BUY_ORDER')
AND a.DateKey BETWEEN CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.KnownAt,112)) AND CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),i.AnalysisEnd,112));

name: FactRequestedWindowLine
definition:
CREATE   VIEW cxcontrol.FactRequestedWindowLine AS
SELECT w.WindowKey,c.CandidateKey,c.PlanningRunKey,t.TrancheKey,l.InquiryLineKey,l.ProductKey,sp.StockUnitMeasureKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),w.KnownAt,112)) KnownDateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),t.DueDate,112)) DueDateKey,
 CASE WHEN d.FilledQty>=l.RequestedQty THEN COALESCE(CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),d.LastShipmentAt,112)),0) ELSE 0 END CompletionDateKey,
 l.RequestedQty,d.OnTimeQty,d.LateQty,d.FilledQty,d.LostQty,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),l.RequestedQty-d.FilledQty-d.LostQty) EndingBacklogQty,
 CONVERT(bigint,1) InquiryLineCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN d.FilledQty>=l.RequestedQty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CompletedLineCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN d.OnTimeQty>=l.RequestedQty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OnTimeCompleteLineCount
FROM cxcontrol.RequestedWindow w JOIN cxcontrol.WindowCandidate c ON c.WindowKey=w.WindowKey
JOIN cxcontrol.Tranche t ON t.CandidateKey=c.CandidateKey JOIN cxcontrol.InquiryLine l ON l.TrancheKey=t.TrancheKey
JOIN cxolap.DimRun r ON r.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
JOIN dss.Scenario_Product sp ON sp.ScenarioVersionKey=r.ScenarioVersionKey AND sp.ProductKey=l.ProductKey
OUTER APPLY(SELECT
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EventCode='SHIP_ON_TIME' THEN e.Quantity ELSE 0 END),0) OnTimeQty,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EventCode='SHIP_LATE' THEN e.Quantity ELSE 0 END),0) LateQty,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EventCode IN('SHIP_ON_TIME','SHIP_LATE') THEN e.Quantity ELSE 0 END),0) FilledQty,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EventCode='LOST_SALE' THEN e.Quantity ELSE 0 END),0) LostQty,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.EventCode IN('SHIP_ON_TIME','SHIP_LATE') THEN e.EventAt END) LastShipmentAt
 FROM dss.Fact_SimulationEvent e WHERE e.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
 AND e.EntityCode=CONCAT('SO_LINE:',l.SourceSalesOrderDetailID)
 AND e.EventCode IN('SHIP_ON_TIME','SHIP_LATE','LOST_SALE')
 AND CONVERT(date,e.EventAt) BETWEEN w.KnownAt AND w.AnalysisEnd) d;

name: FactRequestedWindowSummary
definition:
CREATE   VIEW cxcontrol.FactRequestedWindowSummary AS
SELECT w.WindowKey,c.CandidateKey,c.PlanningRunKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),w.KnownAt,112)) WindowStartDateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),w.AnalysisEnd,112)) WindowEndDateKey,
 TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(w.RequestJSON,'$.base_run_key')) ReferenceRunKey,
 d.CalendarDays WindowDays,CONVERT(float,d.InventoryValueDaySum)/NULLIF(d.CalendarDays,0) WindowAverageInventoryValue,
 o.DueOrderCount WindowDueOrderCount,o.OnTimeFullOrderCount WindowOnTimeFullOrderCount,
 CONVERT(float,o.OnTimeFullOrderCount)/NULLIF(o.DueOrderCount,0) WindowOTIF,
 rd.CalendarDays ReferenceROPDays,CONVERT(float,rd.InventoryValueDaySum)/NULLIF(rd.CalendarDays,0) ReferenceROPAverageInventoryValue,
 ro.DueOrderCount ReferenceROPDueOrderCount,ro.OnTimeFullOrderCount ReferenceROPOnTimeFullOrderCount,
 CONVERT(float,ro.OnTimeFullOrderCount)/NULLIF(ro.DueOrderCount,0) ReferenceROPOTIF
FROM cxcontrol.RequestedWindow w JOIN cxcontrol.WindowCandidate c ON c.WindowKey=w.WindowKey
JOIN cxolap.DimRun r ON r.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
OUTER APPLY(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.DateKey) CalendarDays,SUM(f.InventoryValueDaySum) InventoryValueDaySum
 FROM cxcontrol.FactSimulationDaily f WHERE f.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
 AND f.DateKey BETWEEN CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),w.KnownAt,112)) AND CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),w.AnalysisEnd,112))) d
OUTER APPLY(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) DueOrderCount,
 COALESCE(SUM(CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN f.CompletedAt IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(date,f.CompletedAt)<=CONVERT(date,f.DueAt) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),0) OnTimeFullOrderCount
 FROM dss.Fact_SimulationOrder f WHERE f.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
 AND CONVERT(date,f.DueAt) BETWEEN w.KnownAt AND w.AnalysisEnd AND CONVERT(date,f.KnownAt)<=w.AnalysisEnd) o
OUTER APPLY(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.DateKey) CalendarDays,SUM(f.InventoryValueDaySum) InventoryValueDaySum
 FROM cxcontrol.FactSimulationDaily f WHERE f.PlanningRunKey=TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(w.RequestJSON,'$.base_run_key'))
 AND f.DateKey BETWEEN CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),w.KnownAt,112)) AND CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),w.AnalysisEnd,112))) rd
OUTER APPLY(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) DueOrderCount,
 COALESCE(SUM(CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN f.CompletedAt IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(date,f.CompletedAt)<=CONVERT(date,f.DueAt) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),0) OnTimeFullOrderCount
 FROM dss.Fact_SimulationOrder f WHERE f.PlanningRunKey=TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(w.RequestJSON,'$.base_run_key'))
 AND CONVERT(date,f.DueAt) BETWEEN w.KnownAt AND w.AnalysisEnd AND CONVERT(date,f.KnownAt)<=w.AnalysisEnd) ro;

name: FactRequestedWindowTranche
definition:
CREATE   VIEW cxcontrol.FactRequestedWindowTranche AS
SELECT w.WindowKey,c.CandidateKey,c.PlanningRunKey,t.TrancheKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),w.KnownAt,112)) KnownDateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),t.DueDate,112)) DueDateKey,
 CASE WHEN f.CompletedAt IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(date,f.CompletedAt)<=w.AnalysisEnd THEN CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),f.CompletedAt,112)) ELSE 0 END CompletionDateKey,
 CONVERT(nvarchar(20),CASE WHEN f.CompletedAt IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(date,f.CompletedAt)<=w.AnalysisEnd THEN 'FULFILLED'
 WHEN f.CancelledAt IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(date,f.CancelledAt)<=w.AnalysisEnd THEN 'LOST' ELSE 'OPEN' END) OrderStatus,
 CONVERT(bigint,1) TrancheCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN f.CompletedAt IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(date,f.CompletedAt)<=w.AnalysisEnd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CompletedTrancheCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN f.CompletedAt IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(date,f.CompletedAt)<=w.AnalysisEnd AND CONVERT(date,f.CompletedAt)<=t.DueDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OnTimeCompleteTrancheCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,CASE WHEN f.CancelledAt IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(date,f.CancelledAt)<=w.AnalysisEnd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) LostTrancheCount,
 CONVERT(bigint,f.ExpectedLineCount) RequestedLineCount
FROM cxcontrol.RequestedWindow w JOIN cxcontrol.WindowCandidate c ON c.WindowKey=w.WindowKey
JOIN cxcontrol.Tranche t ON t.CandidateKey=c.CandidateKey
JOIN cxolap.DimRun r ON r.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey
JOIN dss.Fact_SimulationOrder f ON f.PlanningRunKey=c.PlanningRunKey AND f.CustomerOrderCode=CONCAT('SO:',t.SourceSalesOrderID);

 COALESCE(r.RandomStreamVersion,N'UNSPECIFIED') RandomStreamVersion,
 r.SimulationStartDateKey,r.SimulationEndDateKey,r.InputSnapshotKey,
 r.DataCutoffDateKey,r.DemandInputMode,r.DemandRuleVersion,r.RuleSetVersion,
 r.AttemptNo,r.MetricDefinitionVersion,r.RunAt,r.CompletedAt,
 s.CustomerShipmentMode,s.ShortageHandlingMode,COALESCE(s.LostSalesScope,N'NOT_APPLICABLE') LostSalesScope,
 s.InitialStateRule,s.InventoryValuationRule,s.HoldingCostRatePerYear,
 rs.EvaluationScope,CONVERT(nvarchar(100),N'Published / Succeeded / Passed') Eligibility,
 CONVERT(nvarchar(200),N'Independent run; experiment key alone is not a comparison set') ComparisonScope
FROM dss.v_PlanningRunContext r
JOIN dss.ExperimentCase c ON c.ExperimentCaseKey=r.ExperimentCaseKey
JOIN dss.Dim_ExperimentVersion e ON e.ExperimentVersionKey=c.ExperimentVersionKey
JOIN dss.Dim_ScenarioVersion s ON s.ScenarioVersionKey=r.ScenarioVersionKey
JOIN dss.Dim_PolicyConfigVersion pc ON pc.PolicyConfigVersionKey=r.PolicyConfigVersionKey
JOIN dss.Dim_PolicyType p ON p.PolicyTypeKey=pc.PolicyTypeKey
JOIN dss.Fact_RunSummary rs ON rs.PlanningRunKey=r.PlanningRunKey
WHERE r.RunPurpose=N'SIMULATION' AND r.RunStatus=N'SUCCEEDED'
 AND e.LifecycleStatus=N'PUBLISHED' AND rs.ValidationStatus=N'PASSED';

name: v_PlanningRunContext
definition:
CREATE   VIEW dss.v_PlanningRunContext
AS
SELECT
    r.[PlanningRunKey],
    r.[RunCode],
    r.[RunPurpose],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[ScenarioVersionKey] WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'RECOMMENDATION' THEN r.[ScenarioVersionKey] ELSE CAST(NULL AS bigint) END AS [ScenarioVersionKey],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[PolicyConfigVersionKey] ELSE CAST(NULL AS bigint) END AS [PolicyConfigVersionKey],
    c.[DemandSourceKind],
    COALESCE(r.[ReplicationNo], rep.[ReplicationNo]) AS [ReplicationNo],
    COALESCE(r.[RandomSeed], rep.[BaseSeed]) AS [RandomSeed],
    COALESCE(r.[RandomStreamVersion], rep.[RandomStreamVersion]) AS [RandomStreamVersion],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[DataCutoffDateKey] WHEN r.RunPurpose IN (N'FORECAST', N'RECOMMENDATION') THEN r.[DataCutoffDateKey] ELSE CAST(NULL AS int) END AS [DataCutoffDateKey],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[SimulationStartDateKey] ELSE CAST(NULL AS int) END AS [SimulationStartDateKey],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[SimulationEndDateKey] ELSE CAST(NULL AS int) END AS [SimulationEndDateKey],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[DemandInputMode] ELSE CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(30)) END AS [DemandInputMode],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[DemandRuleVersion] WHEN r.RunPurpose IN (N'FORECAST', N'RECOMMENDATION') THEN r.[DemandRuleVersion] ELSE CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(100)) END AS [DemandRuleVersion],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[RuleSetVersion] WHEN r.RunPurpose IN (N'FORECAST', N'RECOMMENDATION') THEN r.[RuleSetVersion] ELSE CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(200)) END AS [RuleSetVersion],
    r.[RunStatus],
    r.[RunAt],
    r.[CompletedAt],
    r.[RunNote],
    r.[LoadBatchID],
    r.[DemandBucket],
    r.[HistoryWindowPeriods],
    r.[ForecastModel],
    r.[ForecastHorizonPeriods],
    r.[SigmaMethod],
    r.[PromoKnowledgeLeadDays],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[InputSnapshotKey] WHEN r.RunPurpose IN (N'FORECAST', N'RECOMMENDATION') THEN r.[InputSnapshotKey] ELSE CAST(NULL AS bigint) END AS [InputSnapshotKey],
    r.[ExperimentCaseKey],
    r.[ExperimentReplicationKey],
    r.[AttemptNo],
    r.[MetricDefinitionVersion],
    CASE WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION' THEN c.[SourceForecastRunKey] WHEN r.RunPurpose = N'RECOMMENDATION' THEN r.[SourceForecastRunKey] ELSE CAST(NULL AS bigint) END AS [SourceForecastRunKey],
    r.[ExperimentVersionKey],
    r.[RunRequestId],
    r.[ExecutionSpecHash],
    r.[ExecutionSpecVersion],
    r.[ExecutionSpecReference]
FROM dss.Dim_PlanningRun AS r
LEFT JOIN dss.ExperimentCase AS c
  ON r.RunPurpose = N'SIMULATION'
 AND c.ExperimentVersionKey = r.ExperimentVersionKey
 AND c.ExperimentCaseKey = r.ExperimentCaseKey
LEFT JOIN dss.ExperimentReplication rep ON rep.ExperimentReplicationKey=r.ExperimentReplicationKey;

name: v_SimulationOrderLine
definition:
CREATE   VIEW dss.v_SimulationOrderLine
AS
WITH B AS (
 SELECT e.PlanningRunKey,e.EntityCode,c.InputSnapshotKey,e.SourceRecordReference,
 e.ProductKey,CONVERT(date,e.DueAt) DueDate,ds.CalendarDate StartDate,de.CalendarDate EndDate,
 e.IsOpeningEntity,e.OriginalQty,e.OpeningRemainingQty,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),CASE WHEN e.IsOpeningEntity=1 THEN e.OpeningRemainingQty ELSE e.OriginalQty END) Q0,
 CONVERT(date,e.CreatedAt) CreatedDate,e.CustomerOrderCode,
 CASE WHEN e.IsOpeningEntity=1 THEN i.ClosedBeforeStartQty ELSE CONVERT(decimal(28,8),0) END ClosedBeforeStartQty
 FROM dss.RunEntity e
 JOIN dss.v_PlanningRunContext c ON c.PlanningRunKey=e.PlanningRunKey
 JOIN dss.Fact_RunSummary s ON s.PlanningRunKey=e.PlanningRunKey AND s.ValidationStatus=N'PASSED'
 JOIN dss.Fact_SimulationOrder o ON o.PlanningRunKey=e.PlanningRunKey AND o.CustomerOrderCode=e.CustomerOrderCode
 JOIN dw.Dim_Date ds ON ds.DateKey=c.SimulationStartDateKey
 JOIN dw.Dim_Date de ON de.DateKey=c.SimulationEndDateKey
 LEFT JOIN dss.Scenario_InitialCustomerOrder i ON i.ScenarioVersionKey=e.ScenarioVersionKey AND i.DemandLineCode=e.InitialDemandLineCode
 WHERE c.RunPurpose=N'SIMULATION' AND c.RunStatus=N'SUCCEEDED' AND e.EntityType=N'CUSTOMER_ORDER_LINE'
 AND CONVERT(date,e.CreatedAt)<=de.CalendarDate
), Periods AS (
 SELECT B.*,v.LateStart,
 CASE WHEN v.LateStart<=EndDate THEN DATEDIFF(day,v.LateStart,EndDate)+1 ELSE 0 END LateDayCount
 FROM B CROSS APPLY(SELECT MAX(d) LateStart FROM (VALUES(StartDate),(DueDate),(CreatedDate)) x(d)) v
), E AS (
 SELECT b.PlanningRunKey,b.EntityCode,f.EventSequence,f.EventAt,CONVERT(date,f.EventAt) EventDate,
 f.EventCode,f.Quantity,b.Q0,b.LateStart,b.EndDate,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.EventCode IN(N'SHIP_ON_TIME',N'SHIP_LATE') THEN f.Quantity ELSE CONVERT(decimal(28,8),0) END)
 OVER(PARTITION BY b.PlanningRunKey,b.EntityCode ORDER BY f.EventAt,f.EventSequence ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) RunningFilled
 FROM Periods b JOIN dss.Fact_SimulationEvent f ON f.PlanningRunKey=b.PlanningRunKey AND f.EntityCode=b.EntityCode
 WHERE CONVERT(date,f.EventAt) BETWEEN b.StartDate AND b.EndDate
 AND ((f.EventCode=N'SHIP_ON_TIME' AND CONVERT(date,f.EventAt)<=b.DueDate)
 OR (f.EventCode=N'SHIP_LATE' AND CONVERT(date,f.EventAt)>b.DueDate)
 OR f.EventCode=N'LOST_SALE')
), A AS (
 SELECT PlanningRunKey,EntityCode,
 SUM(CASE WHEN EventCode=N'SHIP_ON_TIME' THEN Quantity ELSE 0 END) OnTimeQty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN EventCode=N'SHIP_LATE' THEN Quantity ELSE 0 END) LateQty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN EventCode=N'LOST_SALE' THEN Quantity ELSE 0 END) LostQty,
 MAX(CASE WHEN EventCode IN(N'SHIP_ON_TIME',N'SHIP_LATE') THEN EventDate END) LastDeliveryDate,
 MIN(CASE WHEN EventCode IN(N'SHIP_ON_TIME',N'SHIP_LATE') AND RunningFilled>=Q0 THEN EventDate END) FullDeliveryDate,
 SUM(Quantity*CONVERT(decimal(10,0),CASE WHEN LateStart>EndDate THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(day,CASE WHEN EventDate>LateStart THEN EventDate ELSE LateStart END,EndDate)+1 END)) RemovedUnitDays
 FROM E GROUP BY PlanningRunKey,EntityCode
), Q AS (
 SELECT b.*,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),COALESCE(a.OnTimeQty,0)) OnTimeQty,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),COALESCE(a.LateQty,0)) LateQty,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),COALESCE(a.LostQty,0)) LostQty,
 a.LastDeliveryDate,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.LostQty,0)=0 AND b.ClosedBeforeStartQty=0 THEN a.FullDeliveryDate END CompletionDate,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),b.Q0*b.LateDayCount-COALESCE(a.RemovedUnitDays,0)) LateUnitDays
 FROM Periods b LEFT JOIN A a ON a.PlanningRunKey=b.PlanningRunKey AND a.EntityCode=b.EntityCode
)
SELECT PlanningRunKey,EntityCode,InputSnapshotKey,SourceRecordReference,ProductKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),DueDate,112)) DueDateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),StartDate,112)) EvaluationStartDateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),EndDate,112)) EvaluationEndDateKey,
 IsOpeningEntity,OriginalQty OriginalOrderQty,OpeningRemainingQty,Q0 ObligationQty,
 OnTimeQty,LateQty,CONVERT(decimal(28,8),OnTimeQty+LateQty) FilledQty,LostQty,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),Q0-OnTimeQty-LateQty-LostQty) UnfilledQtyAtEnd,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),CASE WHEN DueDate<=EndDate THEN Q0-OnTimeQty-LateQty-LostQty ELSE 0 END) OverdueUnfilledQtyAtEnd,
 LateUnitDays,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),LastDeliveryDate,112)) LastDeliveryDateKey,
 CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),CompletionDate,112)) CompletionDateKey,
 CASE WHEN CompletionDate IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CompletionDate<=DueDate THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(day,DueDate,CompletionDate) END CompletionLateDays,
 CONVERT(nvarchar(30),CASE WHEN DueDate<StartDate THEN N'OPENING_OVERDUE' WHEN DueDate>EndDate THEN N'FUTURE_DUE' ELSE N'DUE_IN_RUN' END) EvaluationCohort,
 CONVERT(bit,CASE WHEN DueDate BETWEEN StartDate AND EndDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) IsDueInEvaluationPeriod,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),CASE WHEN DueDate BETWEEN StartDate AND EndDate THEN Q0 ELSE 0 END) OTUDemandQty,
 CONVERT(decimal(28,8),CASE WHEN DueDate BETWEEN StartDate AND EndDate THEN OnTimeQty ELSE 0 END) OTUOnTimeQty,
 CustomerOrderCode
FROM Q;
